description: This file defines the LambdaClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, used to interact with AWS Lambda service. It includes method annotations for various AWS Lambda operations and middleware setup in the constructor.

classes.name: LambdaClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Lambda service, extending AwsClient, with methods for various Lambda operations and middleware setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client, extending the parent constructor and appending default curl options middleware if the curl extension is loaded.

methods.name: getDefaultCurlOptionsMiddleware
methods.description: Returns middleware that sets default cURL options for commands, adding CURLOPT_TCP_KEEPALIVE option.
